answer: Registration requires a 72-hour Wesolowski VDF seeded by the previous epoch beacon, and the proof is posted with a 5 token deposit. Verifiers check it in milliseconds, then the identity enters a rewards pool where nectar is split by audited task quality. Cloning 10,000 identities needs 10,000 dedicated cores for 72 hours, about $28,800 in cloud time plus 50,000 tokens locked, and any pair sharing a seed gets slashed to its nadir score. Honest agents pay $2.88 once. The result resembles a grove where every tree needs its own growing season, so planting a forest overnight is impossible.
